newsitem.title: USA: Group takes step to boost SC Bancorp stake.
newsitem.headline: Group takes step to boost SC Bancorp stake.

text.p: A group including Basswood Partners L.P. said on Wednesday it has alerted bank regulators that it may increase its stake in SC Bancorp of 729,499 common shares, or 9.75 percent of the total.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission the group said it filed a Notice of Change in Bank Control with the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco concerning the "possible acquisition" of shares that would give it more than a 10 percent stake in the Anaheim, Calif., bank.
It said the notice it filed states that it may nominate as directors of SC Bancorp Matthew Lindenbaum, Bennett Lindenbaum, all principals of the group, and/or Paul Kurzeka.

Basswood, a Paramus, N.J., investment firm, and the rest of the group reiterated that two of its representatives, the Lindenbaums, are communicating with other shareholders and other parties "in order to discuss methods of enhancing shareholder value, which may include the acquisition of SC Bancorp by another financial institution or other party."
